digest.component_or_area: CLI argument parsing and command dispatch
propositions: Advanced command grammars are scattered across inline argparse construction with manual dispatch; they must be consolidated into reusable S2a side-effect-free factory contract without optional runtime imports
Parser factories must preserve handler-owned nested command selection, lean modes, backend/mode selection, diagnostics, and exit codes while becoming deterministically generation-ready for S2d
ParseError exception handling must replace SystemExit(2) translation in migrated commands while maintaining identical exit codes (2) and stderr/usage bytes in production paths
Parser construction must succeed in no-extras environment and import no Pydantic AI, FastAPI, Jira transport, workflow executor, or other optional runtime dependencies
Bespoke parser presentation (usage=, RawDescriptionHelpFormatter, add_help=False) for specific command families must be preserved through optional keyword passthroughs in S2a factory
All advanced routes must have valid factory references and pass deterministic parser-construction readiness tests with heavy optional modules import-blocked
